data.title: Air Canada Named Best Airline in North America at the 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards
data.description: Air Canada has been awarded the title of Best Airline in North America for the second consecutive year at the prestigious 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards, marking their tenth win since 2010. The awards, based on feedback from millions of travelers worldwide, were held in London, UK. Furthermore, the Toronto Air Canada Signature Suite secured the top spot as the World’s Best Business Class Lounge Dining for the third year running. Air Canada also received accolades for Best Cabin Crew in Canada, Best Economy On Board Catering in North America, and Best Business Class Lounge in North America.

data.title: Avangrid Foundation Supports Future Energy Workforce Through Scholarships at Kennebec Valley Community College
data.description: The Avangrid Foundation, linked to energy giant Avangrid Inc., part of the Iberdrola Group, has granted $10,000 to Kennebec Valley Community College (KVCC) for the Avangrid Foundation/Central Maine Power Scholarship Fund. This funding aims to offer five scholarships worth $2,000 each to students in KVCC's Electrical Lineworker Technology and Electrical Technology programs for the academic year 2026-2027. This initiative seeks to support students pursuing careers in the energy sector.
